tonight.headline: The lineup is set; the Jaguars D/ST lock at 19:15
body: Bad news first. Garrett Wilson missed Thursday's practice too and is unlikely to play (Cimini via Yahoo 5 Nov). He is already on your bench. George Pickens, the first receiver cover, was limited again Thursday.

The 15:19 swaps made the lineup the projection lineup: 133.5 against Jackrabbits' 124.0. Tuten now looks likely to play tonight (Fowler, ESPN, ~15:50 CDMX). That changes nothing here — Gordon still out-projects him in the FLEX, a coin flip the projection takes. Nothing to do before kickoff.

worthALook.name: Mike Washington Jr.
worthALook.lead: A free agent here — no priority — but Kubiak will not name a lead back.

case.label: The player
case.body: 60% of snaps, 25 carries for 83, no targets in Week 8; Jeanty a season-low 40% (CBS 3 Nov). Kubiak: the backfield is 'always a moving target', snaps to whoever plays best (Yahoo 4 Nov). Graziano: Las Vegas are content to tilt carries to Washington unless Jeanty responds (Bleacher Report 4 Nov). FantasyPros (5 Nov): best left on the bench this week — San Francisco allow the lowest explosive-run rate over five games.

case.label: Why not
case.body: Bloodsports carry five backs, and Marks — the obvious drop — has Houston's backfield with Montgomery out (DraftSharks 4 Nov).

case.label: When to act
case.body: A second week as the lead at San Francisco, and Montgomery back in Houston — then a free-agent add for Marks.
